॥ śrīḥ ॥ bṛhatsāmudrikaśāstra। (strīpuruṣayakṣaṇa.) ayodhyāmaṇḍalāntarvartilakhīmapurakhīrīnivāsiyo- tivatpāṇḍatanārāyaṇaprasa damaśraṅkṛta bhāpāṭīkāsahita । gaṅgāmiṣṭaṃ śrīkṛṣṇadāsane apane lakṣmīveṃkaṭeśvara ra chāpekhānemeṃ । chāpakara prasiddha kiyā । saṃvat 1963, śake 1828 kṣaṇa-muṃbaī. isa pustakakā rajiṣṭarī sala haṃka yantrādhikārbane sana 37 ke āvaḍa 29 ve varjaya rakhā hai. P. B.SACH. 109 ॥ śrīḥ ।। bṛhatsāmudrikaśāstra । (strīpuruṣalakṣaṇa.) 080- ayodhyāmaṇḍalāntardhartiūkhīmapurakhīrīnetāti jyotirvitpaṇḍitanārāyaṇaprasādabhitra kṛtabhāṣāṭīkāsahita । isako gaṃgāviṣṇu śrīkṛṣṇadāsane apane "lakṣmīveṃkaṭeśvara chāpekhāne meṃ chāpakara prasiddha kiyā. saṃvat 1963, śake 1828. kalyāṇa-muṃbaī. rajiṣṭī dvārā satvādhikārako mantrādhikārīne apane svādhīna rakhā hai।
bhūmikā । vidita ho ki sāmudrikaśāstrī jyotiṣaśāstrakā eka mukhya aṃga , ki jisase striyoṃ aura puruṣoke śubhāśubha lakṣaṇa bhalī bhāṃti jāne jā sakate haiṃ । jyotiṣaśāstrameṃ gaṇita aura phalita nāmase do bheda hai, gaṇitako to sabahī vidvāna satya mānate haiṃ parantu phalitako aneka vidvāna satya nahīṃ mānate। hamako to phalitabhī satyahī pratīta hotā hai, paraṃtu phalitako kahane ke liye prathama usake manana karanekī parama āvaśyakatā hai। deśa meda ahagaṇitaṃ jātaphamavalokya niṣaśepamapi ॥ yaḥ kathayāti śubhāśubhaṃ tasya na mithyā bhavedvāṇī ।। 1।। ' jaise ki, hama yahāṃ kucha cihna, puruṣa aura striyāṃke likhate haiṃ, ki jinakī kaī bāra parīkṣā huī hai aura saśe nikāleṃ । jisa puruṣakā varṇa gaura, kṛśa śarīra aura sūkṣma deha tathā kalāī aura jaṃghāpara bāla bahuta ho, vaha atyanta kāmī aura bahuputra hotā hai । jisakā deha laṃbā, barṇa godhūmakā, atyanta catura aura kṛśa deha ho, vaha putrahīna vā svalpasantāna hotā hai । ja। hasvagrīva, sūkṣma deha, caṃcala svabhāva ho vaha kapaṭī aura chalī hotā hai । kāṇā, khalvāṭa, khaṃja, tathā viḍālanetrakā puruṣa pāpātmā, kuṭila, aviśvāsapātra hotā hai। jisake liṃgama vāmāṃga ṭeṭā ho vaha kanyākī santānavālā, aura jisake dakṣiṇāṃga ṭeḍhaā ho vaha putrasantatimāna hotā hai । tathā jo laṃva deha, sthūla kāya, bahubhāṣī aura uccaśabdavālā ho vaha mānī, ahaṃkārī hotā hai । madhyakāya, bhārī deha, gaura varṇa, śīghra bolanevālā jisakī jillā bolane meṃ cakaṭatī hai। bā bhedadantī ho, vaha avaśya catura vidvāna tathā guṇī aura bahuputra hotā hai । kṛṣṇavarṇa, hṛsvatanu, kurūpa ṛrātmā, avaśya jhūṭhā, chalī, ṭhaga hotā hai ।। jaisā puruṣakā vyavahāra hai vaisāhī khiryokā hai, jo strī hasvakāya, śyāmanayanā। ho vaha vyabhicāriṇī hotī hai । jisake caraṇakī tarjanī aṃguṣṭhase laṃbī ho vaha vyāmacāriṇī tathā vidhavā hotī hai । jisake harata, pāda bhārī, aṃgulī choṭī, kiṃcit sthūlakāya, madhyadeha, gauravarṇa ho vaha bhī vyabhicāriṇī nirlajjā aura ni- bhaiyā hotī hai। laṃbī tathā kṛśadeha, piṃḍalī aura kalāī para bāla, śīghragāminī jisakā pāṃva madhyase pṛthivīpara na lage vahabhī vyabhicāriṇī hotī hai। jisake kaṃdha, kuca, nitamba, calanemaṃ hilaṃ tathā śīghra aura tirachī vahabhī vyabhicāriṇī hotī hai ityādi lakṣaṇase svabhāva guṇa, aguṇa tathā āyu pahicānī jā sakatī hai। sāmu- kiśāstrameṃ manana karanese aura parīkṣāse śarīrasya lakṣaṇāṃkā yathārtha jñāna ho jātā hai। . 01 Lc 7 1- b.an ,,।7।। sampūrṇa śubhāśubha phala । kathana karanā ॥2॥ śivoktaṃ taṃtrasāmudraṃ kararekhāśubhāśubham ॥ yasya vijñānamātreṇa puruṣoṃ nahi śocati ॥3॥ artha-śrīśiva ( mahādevajī ) ke kahe hue sāmudrikaśāstrameṃ hāthakī rekhāse śubhāśubhakī vyasthā likhī hai, jisa śubhāśubha arthāt sukhaduḥkhake bhalī bhāṃti jānanemāse manuṣya śokako prāpta nahīṃ hotā arthāt sukhī rahatā hai ॥ 3॥ sāmudrikaśāstram । rājacihna । janane pravalo yasya rājayogo bhavedyadi ॥ kare vā caraṇo'vaśyaṃ rājacihna prajāyate ॥4॥ artha-jisake janmasamaya pravala rājayoga hove usake hātha vā। pāṃvameṃ padma ādi rājacihna avaśya hotā hai ॥ 4 ॥ anāmā mūlagā rekhā saiva puṇyābhidhā matā ॥ madhyamāṃgulimārabhya maṇibandhāntamāgatā ॥5॥ artha-anāmā (kaniṣṭhikā aura madhyamāke bīcakī aṃgulī) ke mūlameṃ jo sīdhī rekhā hove to vaha puṇyakī denevālī śubha hotī hai aura vīca kī aṃgulīse leke maṇibandha arthāt hāthakī jaḍataka jo sīdhī aura pūrṇa ekahī rekhā hove tobhī śubha hotī hai ॥5॥ vaisāraṇo vātavāraṇo vā coddhāraṇo dakṣiṇapā- ṇimadhye ॥ sarovaraṃ cakuśa evaṃ yasya vīṇā ca rājā bhuvi jāyate saḥ ॥6॥ artha-jisake dāhine hāthameṃ machalī, chatra, hāthī, tālāva aura aṃkuśa vā vīṇā inameṃ se jo koībhī cihna hove to vaha manuṣya pṛthvīmeṃ rājā hove ॥ 6॥ muśalaśelukṛpāṇahalāṅkitaṃ karatale kila yasya sa vittapaḥ ॥ kusumamālikayā phalamīdṛśaṃ nṛpa- tireva nṛpālubhuvo yadā ॥ 7 ॥ artha-jisakā hātha muśala, parvata, talavāra, hula ina cihnoṃse yukta ho vaha avaśya dhanavāna hove aura jo phūlako mālākā cihna hoye tabhī dhanavāna have tathā rājakulameṃ utpanna ho aura yaha cihna ho to rājā hove ।। 7॥ bhāṣāṭīkāsahitam ।। ūrdurekhāphala । soddha rekhā viśeṣeṇa rājyalābhakarī bhavet ॥ khaṇḍitā duṣṭaphalūdā kṣīṇā kṣīṇaphalapradā॥8॥ artha-ūrdhvarekhā vaha hai jo bīcakī aṃgulīse hāthakī jaḍataka apūrṇa ekahī rekhā hotī hai, so viśeṣakarake rājyalābha karānevālī hotī hai, jo ūrdhva rekhā khaṃḍita ho to duṣṭa phala detī hai aura jo kṣīṇa ho to kṣīṇa phala detī hai ॥ 8 ॥ । yavākāracihnaphala ।। aṃguṣṭhamadhye puruṣasya manuṣya apane vaṃśameṃ bhūṣaṇa tathā ābhūṣaṇa aura strījana tathā dhanase yukta hotā hai ॥ 9 ॥ । lakṣmīprāpticihna ।। karatale'pi ca pādatale nṛṇāṃ turagapaṃkajacāpara- thāṅgavat ॥ unake sthānameṃ śreṣṭha lakṣmī sarvadā nivāsa kare ॥ 10 ॥ । akhaṇḍalakṣmīcihna । kumbhaḥ stambho vā turaṅgī mṛdaṅgaḥ pāṇāvaṃghau vā drumo yasya puṃsaḥ ॥cañcaddaṇḍo'khaṇḍalakṣmyā parī- taḥ kiṃvā so'yaṃ paṇḍitaḥ śauṇḍiko vā ॥ 11 ॥ sāmudrikaśāstram । artha-jisake hathelī vā caraṇake talavepara kalaśa, khaṃbha, ghoḍā, vṛkṣa, lāṭhī ye cihna hoṃ vaha akhaṃḍa lakṣmīse yukta hove athavā paṃḍita vā śāṇḍika ( madirā becanevālā) hove ॥ 11 ॥ uttamarājacihna । viśālabhālo'mbujapatranetraḥ suvṛttamauliḥ kṣiti- maṇḍaleśaḥ ॥ ājānubāhuḥ puruṣaṃ tamāhuḥ kṣoṇī- bhṛtāṃ mukhyataraṃ mahāntaḥ ॥ 12 ॥ artha-jisakā
